wake ign too far away, needed to go in and readjust igniter, ignition started again at 10:50 gmt. Flame spread all the way upstream. Went out at 0.32 pot, got spherical and flashed out.

sample is actually down to about 1 cm, GN2 pot actually set to 8, reading 397, flow start 12:41 flow stop 14:44:30, final O2 is 17.3%. Had Chris anneal the igniter before ignition. We lost video during ignition for a minute or two. Chris didn't press shutter until Paul told him we lost video. So images start late. Will need to schedule playback of this test. Flame went out when fan set to 39. Playback attempted 15:47 but it was streaky.

new candle, started GN2 at 15:26 00 gmt 15:31:10 msg stopped gmt 17:20:20, O2 16.8%. Bracketing images 7 s hold. Filled up card with bracket images. Chris noted the flame was not moving at all, unlike the 'contamination' of the acrylic shape. At 42 (pot 0.5) was all blue initially, but had soot after a bit. At 41 (pot 0.4), flame was steady all blue.

changed out card for unknown card, 1 handed with glove on! Hopefully it wasn't #6! We still don't have that data. Got sooty pretty quickly, turned up accidentally to 43 pot, tnen down to 41. went out on its own at 18:04:30 ish. He described it as being the side of a pencil eraser, with the back end open.

new sphere, issue with numbers, sample 20 is a stump, completely gone. LOS for setup/GN2 start Gn2 on 10:44 pff 12:26 , vitiation to 17.3 % o2. Lots of vapor jetting at low flow. At 0.33 pot flame got all blue just around stagnation region. Last pic still had a flame~3:15 burn
Gn2 start, max, at msg 13:07:40, off 14:54:55, O2 17.1% O2. Igniter broke, he replaced it 1 handed! Igniton at 62 then turned down to 41.5 then 41 (0.35 pot), stable at 0.35 pot. Out when fan off.
Igniter too far away readjusted 1 handed. Over the shoulder view, out of focus a bit. Burned out sample. Held up sample to camera view, just crunchy bits on the end.

new sphere, issue with numbers, sample 20 is a stump, completely gone. LOS for setup/GN2 start Gn2 on 10:44 pff 12:26 , vitiation to 17.3 % o2. Lots of vapor jetting at low flow. At 0.33 pot flame got all blue just around stagnation region. Last pic still had a flame~3:15 burn
Gn2 start, max, at msg 13:07:40, off 14:54:55, O2 17.1% O2. Igniter broke, he replaced it 1 handed! Igniton at 62 then turned down to 41.5 then 41 (0.35 pot), stable at 0.35 pot. Out when fan off.
Igniter too far away readjusted 1 handed. Over the shoulder view, out of focus a bit. Burned out sample. Held up sample to camera view, just crunchy bits on the end.
Ign in 1 min. Symmetric growth. Gets sooty, even when flow reduced to 41. Gets all blue at 18:38, out at 18:40 at finite extremely low flow.
repeated ignition attempts, no luck at 52, brief flame at 62 but also 'flamed out'. Chris says 1/3 of sphere is gone from wake region. Need to readjust igniter wire.

took about 3 min to ignite, repeated attempts. Got blue flame that was 1/2 way or mor around top. Turned fan down in increments:12:10:20 0.6 (43); 11:15 0.5 (42); 11:50 0.35 (41) and 12:35 0.32 (41) flame self-extinguished.

flame lit on 2nd try, quickly turned sooty, spread around small remaining sphere. All blue at lower flows, burned out fuel. Very nice over the shoulder zoomed in view of flame. Better than expt video!

repeated ignition attempts, no luck keeping the flame sustained. After igniter retract, the blue flame leading edge shrinks back, the tail shrinks, the flame becomes parallel to the fuel surface, and then winks out. Apparently not flammable in opposed flow for the same concurrent flow. Heat losses are different though, due to the metal holder around the back end of sample but not on front edge.

moved igniter upstream of 'crater' we created on last test. Got a flame briefly, but did not sustain for any spread, shrank and winked out after maybe 15 s or so. Broke the igniter trying to re-ignite.

broke 2 igniters on this trying to get it to ignite. 3rd one was suspect, and didn't work. 2nd vitiation, got it ignited, burned just on forward stagnation region, minimal spread. Went out at finite flow. Post burn shape was crater and protrusion on lower half.

started igniting the protrusion and then went LOS for a minute. Came back and sample bump is gone, pot down to flow of 2 cm/s, radiometer increased so still growing flame. Pot to 0.4 and flame still growing fan 41.5, pot 0.33 radiometer drops to 0.7, fan 41, down to 0.3 but camera ran out and we shut off flow to put flame out. Sample shape much more spherical.
no ignition, despite prolonged attempted ignition. No pictures were taken. Candle out of wax?
nice blue flame with inner soot until low flows. At extinction, the stag zone opened up before the flame goes out (out of wax).
new sample. Blue flame wrapped around leading edge, didn't propagate at all. Went out on its own at a flow of 0.4 after 75 seconds
new sphere, took 4 min to ignite with repeated tries and brief flames . All blue to start, grew to wrap past 90 degrees . Short burn about 2 minutes.

broke igniter just before it was going to stay lit. New igniter trying again. Repeat of test 50. takes 4 min to ignite sphere at this O2. blue flame. Post-burn sample had large amounts of soot on it that had to be wiped off.
broke igniter. All blue with intermittent soot balls streaking back. Might be able to get flow measurements from those. Lab view zoomed in on flame also.
broke 2 igniters. No ignition on this test. No stills. Record for the day - broke 4 igniters!

new igniter, anneal it. 3 min to ignite, turned flow to 7 cm/s, let it wrap around sphere, then reduced flow to < 1 cm/s. All blue flame. Nice video from the over the shoulder view. Sphere is very flat on front,w ith blackened bubble layer extending past 90 degreees on the sphere. Back ~40% of sphere still fairly pristine.
nice over the shoulder view, very hard to see dim flame in expt video. Ignition in 1.5 min.

stills during ignition.flame ignited over lower part of sphere, wrapped around and then decreased flow to near limit flow, flame shrank forward and oscillated slightly at pot 0.35, went out when pot turned down to 0.29.

got dim flame with stills during ignition, then had Chris do incr and decr flow flame got very long soot tail at around 10 cm/s and dim blue spherical flame at really low flows. Flame went out at pot 0.27, with oscillations and a big flash at extinction.

igniter 20-11 wass reported broken when he was getting it ready. Tested 20-132 and it was fine. Sample ignited briefly - blue curving around leading edge, but went out. Couldn't get it ignited again at leading edge. Adjusted igniter dcownstream. No luck. No stills taken.
tried igniting in air at 10 cm/s. Not enough fuel in forward patch on sample. No flame. So readjusted igniter to downstream patch (~ 1/2 of sample). Igniter 20-13 broken, installing 20-12, uncoiled.
tried to ignite, no joy, just a puff of smoke each time.
stagnation ignition in air. Dynamic flow changes planned after igntion. Good ignition, good dynamics from dim blue to sooty tail. Bracketing was on - 2 brackets plus dark frames.

same as previous, with continuous pictures. Dropped out los for test, got playback of expt video but lost over theshoulder view for most of test. Up to fan 73 down to 39. Limit pot setting about 0.28. 149 total pics -27-2extras for camera check.
